contract: Dashboard Kepala PKBM read-only insight hub for active-period completeness, class readiness, teacher progress, academic decisions, and audit activity.

accessibility.evidence: Verified named regions/headings, read-only labels, keyboard-visible navigation targets, and explicit mobile menu controls in Playwright snapshots.

responsive.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots were inspected; mobile document width matched the 390px viewport with no horizontal overflow.

loading.reason: The server-rendered dashboard has no client loading state.

empty.evidence: Dashboard renders bounded empty-state copy when insight collections have no rows.

error.reason: No error state was triggered during the authenticated smoke check.

partial.evidence: Missing period or empty monitoring collections retain the dashboard structure and explain that data is unavailable.

success.evidence: Active-period metrics, readiness bars, decision counts, and audit activity rendered from live data.

permission.evidence: Kepala PKBM surfaces are explicitly marked read-only and write controls are absent or disabled.

renderedEvidence.observation: Desktop dashboard shows the insight hierarchy, institution metrics, quick actions, report queue, component readiness, class table, teacher progress, decisions, and audit activity without clipping.
Mobile dashboard stacks cards and tables into readable blocks; navigation opens as a drawer and the document has no horizontal overflow.
